title: Instant Pot Dual Action 8‑in‑1 Multi-Cooker with Serve Together™ Smart Timing, 4Qt Pressure Cooker & 2Qt Rice Cooker, Cook Mains & Sides Together, Fast Cooking, PFAS-Free Pot*, Sauté, Slow Cook & More
features: TWO POTS, ONE COMPLETE MEAL: Cook mains and sides at the same time with dedicated cooking zones. The 4QT main pot pressure cooks, slow cooks, sautés, steams, and keeps warm, while the 2QT side pot is perfect for rice, grains, veggies, and more.
SERVE TOGETHER SMART TIMING: Automatically staggers cook times so both pots finish at the same time. Dinner comes together hot, fresh, and ready to serve.
FASTER WEEKNIGHT COOKING: Pressure cooking gets meals on the table up to 70% faster than traditional slow cooking**, helping you reclaim time on busy nights.
SIMPLE, INTUITIVE CONTROLS: One dial, one display, and clear on-screen prompts make it easy to cook with confidence from start to finish.
MULTI-LANGUAGE DISPLAY: Cook more comfortably with support for 10 languages, including English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Danish, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, and Turkish.
RIGHT-SIZED FOR EVERYDAY COOKING: Makes up to four servings, ideal for family dinners or weekly meal prep without oversized bulk.
EASY CLEANUP, LESS MESS : Both pots clean up fast and are dishwasher safe, whether cooking in stainless steel or nonstick.
PROVEN PEACE OF MIND: Built with 10+ proven safety features, including overheat protection and an auto-sealing lid, plus a 1-year limited warranty for extra confidence with every meal.
ACCESSORIES INCLUDED: Stainless‑steel steam rack, rice paddle, and measuring cup included—ready to cook right out of the box.
*Disclaimer: no intentionally added PFAS to cooking surfaces. **Based on pressure cooking performance of the 4QT pot compared to traditional slow cooking methods.
